newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch police arrest four over Hague blaze deaths.
newsitem.headline: Dutch police arrest four over Hague blaze deaths.

text.p: Dutch police said on Saturday they had arrested four men in connection with a fire in March that killed a Turkish woman and five children in their apartment.
The four men are all of Turkish nationality and Kurdish background, a police statement said.
The deaths in a suburb of the Hague caused an outcry at the time among the Netherlands' 25,000-strong Turkish community.
A delegation of Turkish parliamentarians visited the Hague in early April to express their nation's shock and to monitor the police investigation.
The fire broke out at night on March 25, trapping the woman and five children. Her husband and the couple's other five children escaped by jumping from an upstairs window in the modest apartment.

The four suspects, aged between 16 and 26, were also suspected of throwing petrol bombs on the same night in two separate incidents in the same area, police said. They declined to give further details of the arrests, which followed two months of intensive investigations.
